tracks.why_en: Starts day 1.0 at the earliest — M-1 is the first parcel here and it waits on L-0 · LEGAL GATE L-0: no parcel here that touches a retail unit may start until it is answered. Blocked by: L-0 (which is the legal gate).
tracks.why_zh: 开工时点：最早第 1.0 天——本线最先可开工的是 M-1，它须等待 L-0 完成 · 法律前置 L-0：本线中凡涉及零售整机的工作包，未获该答复不得开工。前置条件：L-0（即法律前置）。
tracks.starts: day 1.0 at the earliest — M-1 is the first parcel here and it waits on L-0 · LEGAL GATE L-0: no parcel here that touches a retail unit may start until it is answered
tracks.starts_zh: 最早第 1.0 天——本线最先可开工的是 M-1，它须等待 L-0 完成 · 法律前置 L-0：本线中凡涉及零售整机的工作包，未获该答复不得开工

parcels.title_en: Obtain ONE Microduck for metrology by the route L-0 named, and log it in
parcels.title_zh: 按 L-0 确定的途径取得一台 Microduck 用于测量，并登记
parcels.deliverable: A photographic teardown log: every part as removed, with its position, orientation and fasteners, into images/teardown/ with a numbered index — plus, on page one of that log, the route L-0 authorised and the document that authorises it.
parcels.deliverable_zh: 拆解摄影记录：每个零件在拆下时的位置、朝向与紧固件，编号存入 images/teardown/；并在记录第一页写明 L-0 批准的取得途径及其依据文件。
parcels.acceptance: Every one of the 15 servos, 3 boards, battery and both shells appears in at least one numbered photograph, and the index lists them all. Count photographs against the part list: no part unphotographed. AND the log's first page names the L-0 route. A teardown log with no authorisation on page one is not accepted and the parcel is not complete.
parcels.acceptance_zh: 15 个舵机、3 块电路板、电池与两片壳体，每一项至少出现在一张编号照片中，索引齐全；照片数与零件清单逐一核对，不得有未拍摄的零件。且记录第一页写明 L-0 途径。第一页没有授权说明的拆解记录不予受理，该工作包不算完成。
parcels.depends_note: L-0 must have named the route in writing first — this is a legal gate, not a schedule one
parcels.unblocks: every other parcel in this track, plus M-4/M-5/M-6 and B-1
parcels.needs_note_zh: 需一台按 L-0 途径合法取得的整机（若为购买，则涉及支出，须 Leif 批准）
parcels.evidence: SPEC.md:24 — Pollen's mechanical CAD, BOM and PCBs are not published; out/factory/licence.json Q-E + F14 for the gate
parcels.days_basis: 1 unit: obtain by the L-0 route, receive, unbox and photograph a full teardown. Rate: 2 d per unit, ASSUMED. Elapsed time is longer than the effort — shipping is not engineer-days.
parcels.needs_class_en: a real measurement on real hardware

parcels.title_en: Caliper every printed part against our model
parcels.title_zh: 用卡尺测量每个打印件并与模型比对
parcels.deliverable: out/factory/measure/caliper.json: measured L×W×H and every feature dimension per part, to 0.01 mm, beside our modelled value and the delta. Count the fasteners while the unit is open: how many screws of each length actually come out of it.
parcels.acceptance: Every part in the 30-part print list has a measured row; each row carries an instrument reading, not a modelled number. Deltas over 1.5 mm are listed separately as findings. The screw count is a number, which settles the fastener reconciliation in FACTORY-PACK section 3.3a.
parcels.acceptance_zh: 30 个打印件全部有实测行，每行为仪器读数而非模型值；偏差超过 1.5 mm 的单独列为发现项。螺钉清点结果为一个数字，用以了结 FACTORY-PACK 3.3a 节的紧固件对账。
parcels.unblocks: closes the head-geometry CANNOT DETERMINE, the 1.5 mm rebuild rule and the fastener count
parcels.needs_note_zh: 需卡尺与实物整机
parcels.evidence: HEAD-RECONSTRUCTION.html — photo scale uncertainty ≈4 % ≈5 mm on a 122 mm head; out/factory/reconcile.json fasteners
parcels.days_basis: 30 printed parts x 0.13 engineer-day per part (about 1 h per part: fixture, caliper 3 axes plus features, record), plus counting the screws while the unit is open. Part count MEASURED (out/print/slice.json), rate ASSUMED.
parcels.needs_class_en: a real measurement on real hardware

parcels.title_en: Measure the head shell and eye ring to settle the +9.1 % ratio
parcels.title_zh: 测量头壳与眼圈，判定 +9.1 % 比例差
parcels.deliverable: A verdict on which of {eye ring OD, head width} deviates from our mesh, with the measured mm and the instrument.
parcels.acceptance: Ring OD and shell-rim width both measured to 0.1 mm; the front-view ratio recomputed from measurements rather than photographs; the CANNOT DETERMINE in HEAD-RECONSTRUCTION.html is replaced by a verdict.
parcels.acceptance_zh: 眼圈外径与壳缘宽度均测至 0.1 mm；正视比例改由实测重算而非照片推算；HEAD-RECONSTRUCTION.html 中的未定项由此转为明确判定。
parcels.unblocks: head tooling; the biggest open geometric question
parcels.needs_note_zh: 需卡尺与实物整机
parcels.evidence: HEAD-RECONSTRUCTION.html §1 — front-view ring/width ratio +9.1 %
parcels.days_basis: 2 dimensions, but the work is the setup: scale reference, repeat readings, recompute the front-view ratio. Rate ASSUMED.
parcels.needs_class_en: a real measurement on real hardware

tracks.title_en: Components, electrical identity and the shelf
tracks.title_zh: 元器件识别、电气测量与零件档案
tracks.why_en: Starts day 3.0 at the earliest — M-4 is the first parcel here and it waits on M-1 · LEGAL GATE L-0: no parcel here that touches a retail unit may start until it is answered. Blocked by: M-1, M-2 · plus the legal gate L-0.
tracks.why_zh: 开工时点：最早第 3.0 天——本线最先可开工的是 M-4，它须等待 M-1 完成 · 法律前置 L-0：本线中凡涉及零售整机的工作包，未获该答复不得开工。前置条件：M-1、M-2 · 另加法律前置 L-0。
tracks.starts: day 3.0 at the earliest — M-4 is the first parcel here and it waits on M-1 · LEGAL GATE L-0: no parcel here that touches a retail unit may start until it is answered
tracks.starts_zh: 最早第 3.0 天——本线最先可开工的是 M-4，它须等待 M-1 完成 · 法律前置 L-0：本线中凡涉及零售整机的工作包，未获该答复不得开工
tracks.blocked: M-1, M-2 · plus the legal gate L-0
tracks.blocked_zh: M-1、M-2 · 另加法律前置 L-0

parcels.title_en: Identify every unidentified component from the teardown
parcels.title_zh: 通过拆解确认所有未知元器件
parcels.deliverable: A part number, package and vendor for the speaker, microphone, ToF generation, NFC front-end, camera module and its ribbon.
parcels.acceptance: Each line that currently reads CANNOT DETERMINE in ELECTRONICS-DATASHEET.html carries a marking read off the physical part, photographed.
parcels.acceptance_zh: ELECTRONICS-DATASHEET.html 中目前判为未定的每一行，都载有从实物元件上读取并拍照的标识。
parcels.unblocks: the sourcing lines in track 4 and the electronics BOM
parcels.needs_note_zh: 需实物整机与放大观察设备
parcels.evidence: readiness.json — 10 of 32 bought lines are CANNOT DETERMINE
parcels.days_basis: 6 unidentified components x 0.33 d each: decap or read the marking under magnification, then search the marking to a datasheet. Component count MEASURED (readiness CANNOT DETERMINE rows), rate ASSUMED.
parcels.needs_class_en: a real measurement on real hardware

parcels.title_en: Measure the servo supply voltage on a running unit
parcels.title_zh: 测量运行中整机的舵机供电电压
parcels.deliverable: A meter reading of servo VDD with the robot standing and walking, against the XL330-M288-T published 3.7–6.0 V band.
parcels.acceptance: A number in volts at both states, with the meter and the probe point named. Either the servos see the raw 2S pack (6.6–8.4 V) or they do not; the answer is recorded either way.
parcels.acceptance_zh: 站立与行走两种状态下各给出一个电压数值，并注明所用仪表与测点。舵机是否直接承受 2S 电池电压（6.6–8.4 V），无论结论如何都要记录。
parcels.unblocks: the entire power-path design; the most consequential electrical unknown
parcels.needs_note_zh: 需万用表与一台可运行的整机
parcels.evidence: workflows/RUNNING.md finding 1 — the most important electrical finding in the project
parcels.days_basis: 1 bench session: rail voltages and standby current on a live unit. Rate ASSUMED.

parcels.title_en: Grade the 36 shelf records that need the sample
parcels.title_zh: 根据实物判定 36 项零件记录
parcels.deliverable: Each of the 36 triad part folders updated with the measured frame or dimension it was missing, and re-graded.
parcels.acceptance: `bin/triad check --all` reports fewer CANNOT DETERMINE than the 46 it reports today; every row that changes cites the caliper reading that changed it.
parcels.acceptance_zh: bin/triad check --all 的未定项少于今日的 46 项；每一项变化都引用使其变化的卡尺读数。
parcels.unblocks: the shelf reaching a defensible verdict
parcels.needs_note_zh: 仅需案头工作，但依赖 M-2 与 M-4 的实测数据
parcels.evidence: readiness.json summary.triad_refs — 71 checked, 17 pass, 46 CANNOT DETERMINE
parcels.days_basis: 36 shelf records x 0.125 d each to write the measurement into the folder and re-run bin/triad check. Record count MEASURED (71 refs, 36 gradeable only from a unit), rate ASSUMED.

tracks.title_en: Process capability, coupons, materials and the wall floor
tracks.title_zh: 工艺能力、试件、材料与壁厚下限
tracks.why_en: Starts day one — C-1, C-2, C-3 can begin immediately; C-4 waits until day 1.5. Blocked by: nothing in this plan.
tracks.why_zh: 开工时点：第一天即可开工——C-1、C-2、C-3 可立即开始；C-4 需等到第 1.5 天。前置条件：本计划中无前置。
tracks.starts: day one — C-1, C-2, C-3 can begin immediately; C-4 waits until day 1.5
tracks.starts_zh: 第一天即可开工——C-1、C-2、C-3 可立即开始；C-4 需等到第 1.5 天

parcels.title_en: State the process capability for each process you would use
parcels.title_zh: 给出各拟用工艺的过程能力
parcels.deliverable: Per process (FDM, SLA, injection moulding, CNC): the tolerance you hold in production, the surface finish, and the minimum wall.
parcels.acceptance: A number per process with the standard it is quoted against (e.g. ISO 2768 class, or a Cpk with the sample size). 'As printed' is not a tolerance and is rejected.
parcels.acceptance_zh: 每种工艺给出一个数值并注明所依据的标准（如 ISO 2768 等级，或带样本量的 Cpk）。“按打印状态”不是公差，不予接受。
parcels.unblocks: every drawing's tolerance block; the joint tolerance stack
parcels.needs_note_zh: 需贵厂自有工艺数据
parcels.evidence: docs/MANUFACTURING-REQUIREMENTS.md A4 — every dimension carries a tolerance from a stated basis
parcels.days_basis: 4 processes x 0.375 d: collect the capability statement and turn it into the tolerance basis on our sheets. Process count MEASURED, rate ASSUMED.

parcels.title_en: Print and measure a tolerance coupon on your machines
parcels.title_zh: 在贵厂设备上打印并测量公差试片
parcels.deliverable: A coupon carrying the feature set this design uses — Ø2.2 clearance, Ø4.4 counterbore, Ø1.6 tap pilot, a 2 mm rib, a Ø16 boss and a Ø22 bore — printed and measured on your machines, in your material.
parcels.deliverable_zh: 一件试片，含本设计实际用到的特征集：Ø2.2 间隙孔、Ø4.4 沉孔、Ø1.6 攻丝底孔、2 mm 加强筋、Ø16 凸台与 Ø22 内孔——在贵厂设备上、用贵厂材料打印并测量。
parcels.acceptance: Measured versus nominal for each feature, 5 specimens, with mean and spread. This replaces the CANNOT DETERMINE that currently blocks the whole tolerance stack.
parcels.acceptance_zh: 每个特征给出实测值与名义值对比，5 件试样，并给出均值与离散度。此项将取代目前阻塞整个公差链条的未定项。
parcels.unblocks: every press fit and every bearing seat verdict; and C-4's wall floor
parcels.needs_note_zh: 需打印机、卡尺与耗材
parcels.evidence: out/open — 'This workshop's own printed dimensional band (the whole tolerance stack rests on it)'
parcels.days_basis: 6 feature families x 5 specimens = 30 coupons: 1 d printing (machine time, not engineer time), 1.5 d measuring, 0.5 d writing the capability record. Coupon count is the plan; rates ASSUMED.

parcels.title_en: Provide the material datasheet for the filament you would ship
parcels.title_zh: 提供拟用耗材的材料数据表
parcels.deliverable: Tensile and yield strength in the printed Z (interlayer) direction, not just XY, with the print parameters they were measured at.
parcels.acceptance: A datasheet page or a test report. If only XY data exists, say so — our FEA currently derates an assumed figure and that derating must be replaced by a measured one.
parcels.acceptance_zh: 提供数据表页或试验报告。若只有 XY 方向数据，请如实说明——我方有限元目前对一个假设值做折减，该折减必须由实测值取代。
parcels.unblocks: every safety factor in STRUCTURAL.html
parcels.needs_note_zh: 需贵厂库存耗材的材料数据
parcels.evidence: STRUCTURAL.html — 'Strength of the fitted filament in the printed orientation (every SF rests on it)'
parcels.days_basis: 2 materials: obtain the datasheets, re-run the FEA material sweep on the real numbers. The re-run itself is minutes — cecad.stress is already scripted.

parcels.title_en: Give us a minimum PRINTABLE wall per part, because our sheets cannot
parcels.title_zh: 给出各零件的最小可打印壁厚，因为我方图纸给不出
parcels.deliverable: One number per part: the thinnest wall your process will actually produce on that geometry, and the parts where our geometry goes below it.
parcels.deliverable_zh: 每个零件给出一个数值：贵厂工艺在该几何形状上实际能做出的最薄壁厚，以及我方几何低于该值的零件清单。
parcels.acceptance: A number per part, or an explicit 'no part violates our floor'. This exists because our own sheets cannot answer it: the thinnest-wall figures on out/drawings/microduck-shin are 0.0200 mm (note 3) and 0.03 mm (PRINT/DFM note 2), and note 3 then states that a ray minimum at an edge or a fillet run-out IS NOT A PRINTABLE WALL. So the number on our sheets is explicitly not comparable to a process floor, and no usable substitute is on the sheet.
parcels.acceptance_zh: 每个零件给出一个数值，或明确答复“没有零件低于我方下限”。此项之所以存在，是因为我方图纸回答不了：out/drawings/microduck-shin 上的最小壁厚为 0.0200 mm（注 3）与 0.03 mm（打印/DFM 注 2），而注 3 自己写明——边缘或圆角收尾处的射线最小值不是可打印壁厚。因此图纸上的数字明确不可与工艺下限比较，而图纸上没有给出可用的替代值。
parcels.unblocks: question Q1.3, which cannot be answered from our sheets as they stand
parcels.needs_note_zh: 需贵厂工艺知识；我方提供 STL 与图纸
parcels.evidence: out/drawings/microduck-shin/result.json notes 2 and 3; FACTORY-QUESTIONS Q1.3
parcels.days_basis: 30 parts x 0.05 d for a printable-wall opinion per part once C-1's floor is known. Part count MEASURED, rate ASSUMED. This parcel exists because our own sheets cannot answer the question (see its acceptance test).

tracks.title_en: Sourcing: quotes, lead times, the compute board and the battery
tracks.title_zh: 采购：报价、交期、主控板与电池
tracks.why_en: Starts day one — S-1, S-3 can begin immediately; S-2, S-4 wait until day 3.0. Blocked by: M-1.
tracks.why_zh: 开工时点：第一天即可开工——S-1、S-3 可立即开始；S-2、S-4 需等到第 3.0 天。前置条件：M-1。
tracks.starts: day one — S-1, S-3 can begin immediately; S-2, S-4 wait until day 3.0
tracks.starts_zh: 第一天即可开工——S-1、S-3 可立即开始；S-2、S-4 需等到第 3.0 天

parcels.title_en: Get a ROBOTIS OEM quote for the XL330-M288-T
parcels.title_zh: 取得 ROBOTIS XL330-M288-T 的 OEM 报价
parcels.deliverable: A written quote at 225 / 1 500 / 15 000 units (15 servos × 15 / 100 / 1000 robots), with lead time and MOQ.
parcels.acceptance: A quotation document. No distributor publishes a volume break for this part, so this is the single biggest lever on unit cost and only a quote can answer it.
parcels.acceptance_zh: 一份报价文件。该零件没有任何经销商公布批量价格，因此这是单机成本上最大的一个杠杆，只有报价才能回答。
parcels.unblocks: the entire unit-cost model at volume
parcels.needs_note_zh: 需供应商关系（由工厂对接）
parcels.evidence: readiness.json — servos are 77 % of electronics cost at $358.50 of $465.64
parcels.days_basis: 3 quantity tiers across 32 lines: issue RFQ.html, chase, tabulate. Effort is chasing, not typing. Rate ASSUMED.

parcels.title_en: Resolve the compute board
parcels.title_zh: 确定主控板型号
parcels.deliverable: Either the real SKU fitted in a retail unit, or a chosen replacement with its mechanical and electrical differences listed.
parcels.acceptance: A board that can actually be ordered, in stock, with a lead time. The 1 GB / 32 GB combination stated in the press kit is not a Radxa catalogue SKU and every 1 GB variant read on 2026-09-02 was sold out.
parcels.acceptance_zh: 给出一块真正可下单、有库存、有交期的板。新闻资料中所述 1 GB / 32 GB 组合并非 Radxa 目录型号，且 2026-09-02 查得的所有 1 GB 版本均已售罄。
parcels.depends_note: the teardown says what is actually fitted; a catalogue search alone could not
parcels.unblocks: the compute mount, the HAT connector layout, the power budget
parcels.needs_note_zh: 需与经销商联系，并需拆解结果
parcels.evidence: spec/sourcing.json line B3 — 5 offers, 0 with a stated lead time
parcels.days_basis: 1 decision (which compute board is actually fitted and can actually be ordered), once a marking has been read off the board in the teardown and a distributor has confirmed stock and a lead time.

parcels.title_en: Close the remaining unpriced and lead-time-less lines
parcels.title_zh: 补齐其余物料的价格与交期
parcels.deliverable: A priced offer with a lead time for every bought line that lacks one.
parcels.acceptance: Zero lines in spec/sourcing.json with no priced offer; zero with no lead time. Today 4 lines have no priced offer and 11 have no stated lead time.
parcels.acceptance_zh: spec/sourcing.json 中不再有无报价的项，也不再有无交期的项。今日无报价 4 项、无交期 11 项。
parcels.unblocks: a defensible unit cost and a build schedule
parcels.needs_note_zh: 需与经销商联系
parcels.evidence: readiness.json summary.bought_gaps
parcels.days_basis: the lines with no priced offer or no stated lead time, x 0.17 d each: get it stated in writing. Line counts MEASURED (readiness bought_gaps), rate ASSUMED.

parcels.title_en: Settle WHICH battery pack ships — NP-F550 or np_f970
parcels.title_zh: 确定实际装机的电池组型号——NP-F550 还是 np_f970
parcels.deliverable: One pack, named by manufacturer part number, with its measured L×W×H, its capacity, its protection circuit and its connector, and the power_support cavity re-checked against it.
parcels.deliverable_zh: 确定唯一一款电池组，给出制造商型号、实测长宽高、容量、保护板与连接器，并据此重新核对 power_support 电池腔。
parcels.acceptance: A label read off a real pack, photographed, and a caliper reading of the pack. Our documents say NP-F550 class while the mesh we model is np_f970 at 38.600 × 20.600 × 70.800 mm — the two are different packs with different lengths, and a stranger buying from this pack today can buy the wrong one. Either the cavity fits the pack that ships or it is re-modelled; both outcomes are acceptable, silence is not.
parcels.acceptance_zh: 从实物电池上读取并拍摄标签，并用卡尺测量该电池。我方文档称 NP-F550 级，而我方建模所用网格为 np_f970（38.600 × 20.600 × 70.800 mm）——两者是尺寸不同的电池，今天照本交付包采购的人可能买错。电池腔要么与实际装机电池相符，要么重做；两种结果都可接受，不作答复不可接受。
parcels.depends_note: the label is on the pack inside the unit
parcels.unblocks: B-2 (the contact board must fit the pack's real pocket), the power budget, the runtime figure
parcels.needs_note_zh: 需读取实物电池标签并用卡尺测量
parcels.evidence: GOAL.md finding 2; FACTORY-PACK section 3.6; ce-parts/microduck-power-support
parcels.days_basis: 1 pack: read the label on the pack inside the unit, caliper it, re-check the power_support cavity against it. The cavity re-check is minutes; the work is getting a real pack in hand.
parcels.needs_class_en: a real measurement on real hardware

tracks.why_en: Starts day one — B-3a can begin immediately; B-1, B-3 wait until day 3.0 · LEGAL GATE L-0: no parcel here that touches a retail unit may start until it is answered. Blocked by: M-1 · plus the legal gate L-0.
tracks.why_zh: 开工时点：第一天即可开工——B-3a 可立即开始；B-1、B-3 需等到第 3.0 天 · 法律前置 L-0：本线中凡涉及零售整机的工作包，未获该答复不得开工。前置条件：M-1 · 另加法律前置 L-0。
tracks.starts: day one — B-3a can begin immediately; B-1, B-3 wait until day 3.0 · LEGAL GATE L-0: no parcel here that touches a retail unit may start until it is answered
tracks.starts_zh: 第一天即可开工——B-3a 可立即开始；B-1、B-3 需等到第 3.0 天 · 法律前置 L-0：本线中凡涉及零售整机的工作包，未获该答复不得开工
tracks.blocked: M-1 · plus the legal gate L-0
tracks.blocked_zh: M-1 · 另加法律前置 L-0

parcels.title_en: Reverse-engineer the boards from the physical samples
parcels.title_zh: 从实物逆向电路板
parcels.deliverable: A schematic per board with every component and every net, traced from the board itself.
parcels.acceptance: Every net traceable end to end; every component with a marking read off the part. The two currently-guessed parts — the Dynamixel half-duplex transceiver and the 2S→5V regulator — are identified, not inferred.
parcels.acceptance_zh: 每条网络可端到端追踪；每个元件都有从实物上读取的标识。目前仅靠推断的两个元件——Dynamixel 半双工收发器与 2S 转 5V 稳压器——必须确认而非推断。
parcels.unblocks: B-2 and B-3; nothing ships without these
parcels.needs_note_zh: 需实物电路板、放大设备与万用表
parcels.evidence: PCB-PACKAGE.html — Robot HAT reconstruction fails its own DRC

parcels.title_en: Measure the HAT pocket in the motor support against Pollen's 65.0000 × 30.9001 mm board
parcels.title_zh: 测量电机支架上的 HAT 板槽，核对 Pollen 的 65.0000 × 30.9001 mm 板
parcels.deliverable: A clearance number in mm between Pollen's published board outline and the pocket in microduck-motor-support, in all three axes, with the connector heights checked as well as the outline.
parcels.deliverable_zh: 给出 Pollen 公开板外形与 microduck-motor-support 板槽之间的三轴间隙数值（mm），并同时核对连接器高度，而不只是外形。
parcels.acceptance: A number, not an opinion: does a 30.9001 mm board fit where a 30.0250 mm mesh sits today? The delta is 0.8751 mm. This has never been measured — the motor-support part carries no interface record for the HAT seat — and it is the ONLY thing standing between us and answering Q5.4, which is the one move that shortens this whole plan and cleans the licence position at the same time.
parcels.acceptance_zh: 要一个数字，不要判断：30.9001 mm 的板能否装进今天放着 30.0250 mm 网格的位置？差值为 0.8751 mm。此项从未测量过——电机支架零件没有 HAT 座的接口记录——而它是我方回答 Q5.4 前唯一的障碍；Q5.4 又是唯一既能缩短整个计划、又能同时理顺许可关系的一步。

parcels.title_en: Build one unit from the paper alone
parcels.title_zh: 仅依据文件装配一台整机
parcels.deliverable: A build log recording every step where the document was wrong, ambiguous, or assumed knowledge not on the page.
parcels.acceptance: THE THRESHOLD, because this parcel used to accept 'a working unit OR a log of where it stopped' — two branches that both pass, which is no threshold at all. It is complete when the log covers EVERY step of the assembly document with one of three marks: followed as written / followed with a correction (the correction stated) / could not be followed (the reason stated). An unmarked step means the parcel is not finished. A unit that does not power up is a PASS for this parcel and a FAIL for the pack, and the log says which steps caused it.
parcels.acceptance_zh: 判定门槛——本工作包此前的验收是“装出可运行整机，或记录卡在何处”，两个分支都算通过，等于没有门槛。现改为：装配文件的每一步都必须在记录中标注三者之一——按原文执行 / 执行时作了修正（写明修正内容）/ 无法执行（写明原因）。只要有一步未标注，本工作包即未完成。整机上电失败对本工作包是通过，对交付包是失败，记录须写明是哪几步导致的。
parcels.depends_note: boards, printed parts and bought parts must all exist
parcels.unblocks: A-2, A-3, H-1 — and it validates or refutes the whole pack
parcels.needs_note_zh: 需全部零件与一个装配工位
parcels.evidence: ce-assemblies/microduck/current/manual/MANUAL.md; readiness.json assembly row — 23 steps assume knowledge not on the page
parcels.days_basis: 1 unit built for the first time from the paper, marking every step of the assembly document. 23 steps are known to assume knowledge that is not on the page (MEASURED), which is what makes this 3 d and not 1.

parcels.deliverable: A written answer to Q-E: may we lawfully obtain one Microduck and measure it, and by which of the three routes — (a) Pollen's written permission, (b) counsel's opinion that the terms of sale do not bind or are not enforceable against the buyer in the jurisdiction of purchase, or (c) a unit obtained WITHOUT accepting those terms (measured on a unit already owned by a third party who lends it).

critical_path_how: LONGEST PATH over every parcel's depends_on, walked by _longest_path() in tools/gen_workplan.py. It is not a stated chain: an earlier revision claimed [M-1, B-1, B-2, B-3, A-1, Q-1] = 18.0 d 'in series' when B-3 depended on B-1 and not on B-2, so two of those ran in parallel and the series did not exist.

legal_gate.why: Pollen's terms of sale forbid the buyer of a retail unit from dismantling or reverse engineering it (out/factory/licence.json F14); LICENCE-POSITION Q-E is unanswered. No parcel that touches a retail unit may start until L-0 names one of three lawful routes in writing.

effort_note: Every day figure is an ESTIMATE. No measured time-per-item exists in this workshop: 0 units built. Each parcel states the measured COUNT and the assumed per-item rate its estimate is arithmetic on.
